pr_metadata.title: docs(merge-review): leave deleting the private directory to issue-implement
pr_metadata.summary: The merge-review skill no longer claims to delete its private directory after report-ready, which it never sees; it now says its caller, issue-implement, deletes the directory once report-ready has succeeded, and that the directory must survive until then.
pr_metadata.notes: Docs only, one file (skills/merge-review/SKILL.md). Replaces handoff step 3 with a rule that the skill never deletes its directory or the parent issue-implement/<N>/, naming issue-implement as owner of the deletion and stating why the directory must survive (resume after a failed report-ready; security details awaiting a record). The refusal to hand off while a security details file awaits a record is unchanged. The skills index does not repeat the wrong statement, so it is untouched. Does not overlap #930's files. Nothing awaiting a ruling.
